name: sOU Default HUD
releaseNotes:
Round MVP card attached to the matchbar, with source kills/damage and a fixed five-second display, including during pauses and after match end.
Replace the center scoreboard logo via the panel. Matchbar and MVP outside borders and the separate round-win banner are removed.
Competition logo and rotating sponsors now appear above the killfeed. Rotation defaults to ten seconds and is configurable in the Branding panel.
Independent 0-100 percent logo size controls scale width and height together. Remove the observer sponsor footer and RELOAD label; preserve weapon and ammunition during reloading.
Requires sOU desktop 0.3.34 or newer.
